alias.removedText: The tab is named after the folder again: “{{name}}”.

credential.queue_one: Another request is waiting after this one.
credential.queue_other: {{count}} more requests are waiting after this one.

desc.hostKey: This computer has never connected to <host>{{host}}</host> before.
desc.passphrase: The SSH key is protected with a passphrase.
desc.password: <host>{{host}}</host> asks for the password. Many hosts expect an access token here instead of your account password.
desc.passwordUser: <host>{{host}}</host> asks for the password for <user>{{user}}</user>. Many hosts expect an access token here instead of your account password.

credential.compareText: If the fingerprint does not match the one your provider publishes, someone could be reading the connection. In that case, cancel.
credential.rememberHint: Saved only after a successful sign-in. You can delete it in Settings.

launch.confirmText: A link – from a web page, for example – wants to open this folder as a repository:
launch.confirmWarning: Only open it if you know it; otherwise cancel.
launch.blockedText: A link wanted to open {{path}}. Forkyard does not open folders on other computers or device paths from a link. If you really want to open the repository, select it yourself via “Open …”.
launch.notRepoText: The app was asked to open {{path}}, but there is no repository there. Specify the folder that contains “.git” – or create a new one here.
launch.notFoundText: The app was asked to open {{path}}, but the folder does not exist (anymore). Check the path in the command or link.
launch.commitNotFoundText: “{{name}}” is open, but this commit does not exist there. Maybe a fetch is still missing – or the link belongs to a different repository.

status.operationFull: {{name}} in progress{{step}}. Finish or abort it in the commit panel.
status.operationRoute: {{name}} in progress: {{route}}{{step}}. Finish or abort it in the commit panel.
status.detachedHint: No branch is checked out, but commit {{sha}}. New commits belong to no branch until you create one.
status.noUpstreamHint: The branch does not track a remote branch. A push sets up the upstream.
status.zoomResetLimited: Reset zoom – this window applies {{applied}}%; enlarge the window for {{zoom}}%
status.activityHint: Log of the Git commands that were run
status.versionHint: Forkyard {{version}} – open the changelog on GitHub

toolbar.detached: No branch checked out (HEAD is detached)
toolbar.noUpstream: The branch has no upstream – a push creates it
toolbar.nothingToPush: Nothing to push – {{name}} is up to date
toolbar.stashNeedsCommit: A stash needs at least one commit
toolbar.pullRunning: Pull running – cancel it in the status bar
toolbar.pushRunning: Push running – cancel it in the status bar
toolbar.pushNew: Push – asks where to, and creates the remote branch
toolbar.fetchRunning: Fetch running – cancel it in the status bar
toolbar.fetchHint: Query all remotes without changing anything locally
toolbar.branchAt: Create and check out a new branch at the selected commit {{sha}}
toolbar.branchHint: Create and check out a new branch at the current commit
toolbar.popWhat: Apply and remove the latest stash: {{message}}
toolbar.popHint: Apply and remove the latest stash
toolbar.searchHint: Search commits by message, SHA or author
toolbar.statsHint: Commits, authors, hotspots and code age of this repository
toolbar.statsHide: Close the statistics and go back to the previous view

trust.label: Repository confirmation
trust.title: “{{name}}” brings its own commands
trust.text1: Forkyard did not clone or create this repository itself. Its Git folder contains something that Git would run without asking or use to redirect connections. None of it has run so far: no status, no fetch, no hook.
trust.text2: If the folder is yours or comes from a source you trust, this is usually intended (hooks from tools like Husky or Git LFS). If you don't know where it came from – an extracted archive, a copied folder, a link – close the tab.
trust.unreadable: The repository's contents could not be read. It stays locked until you explicitly trust it.
trust.nothingLeft: Nothing suspicious is registered anymore. You can trust the repository.

workspace.nothingSelectedHint: Select a commit in the graph or the row with your local changes.
workspace.missingText: The folder was moved, renamed or deleted – or it is no longer a Git repository. If a drive is not connected, connect it and check again.
